Delhi High Court SPA & PA Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : High Court of Delhi (DHC) has released the notification for the post of Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) & Personal Assistant (PA). This recruitment has been issued for 150 posts. The online application process for Delhi High Court SPA & PA Recruitment 2026 will start from 15 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 05 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Delhi High Court SPA & PA Recruitment 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 05 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 15 September 2026
  • Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Correction Window : 12 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, BC, Female : Rs. 1300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
